name: print-social-thrift-shop-posts-with-retro-serif-and-pastel-colour-bars
title: Thrift shop pack with a chunky retro serif over clothing photos and pastel colour-block bars
whatItIs: Five posts with photos of clothing racks and vintage shoppers, a chunky white retro serif 'thrift shop' with a mustard 'Vintage clothes' line, and bars of pastel colour blocks (terracotta, sage, mustard, peach) along edges, with thin frames and social icons.
whatItMeans: Nostalgic and warm; the retro serif and swatch bars feel like a 70s shop sign.
techniques: Set a chunky retro serif over photos.
Run the title vertically on some posts.
Use a thin inner frame for structure.

vocabulary.definition: A row of colour blocks like paint samples.
A soft heavy serif evoking the 1970s.
